app.QmFzZXJvdw.short_desc.source: Connect to Baserow to manage your database tables, rows, and files with powerful automation
app.QmFzZXJvdw.short_desc.message: Connect to Baserow to manage your database tables, rows, and files with powerful automation

app.QmFzZXJvdw.desc.source: The Baserow integration provides comprehensive access to your Baserow database operations. Create, read, update, and delete rows in your tables, upload files, and monitor new entries with real-time triggers. Whether you need to manage data, filter results, or track new records, this integration streamlines your Baserow workflow automation and database management.
app.QmFzZXJvdw.desc.message: The Baserow integration provides comprehensive access to your Baserow database operations. Create, read, update, and delete rows in your tables, upload files, and monitor new entries with real-time triggers. Whether you need to manage data, filter results, or track new records, this integration streamlines your Baserow workflow automation and database management.

app.QmFzZXJvdw.action.bWFrZS1hcGktY2FsbA.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Baserow** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
